bruciel_app.name: BruCiel historical imagery viewer
bruciel_app.note: The official description reports roughly 5,000 geolocated historical photographs; reuse terms must be checked per asset.

grand_place_dataset.name: City of Brussels Grand Place buildings
grand_place_dataset.note: The committed snapshot contains history and facade text but no official register-year field.

bruciel_1996.name: BruCiel orthophotos 1996
bruciel_1996.status: WMS extract verified for Grand Place bbox (WMS 1.1.1 required)
bruciel_1996.note: 640x480 GetMap with WMS 1.1.1 + SRS EPSG:4326 returns real imagery; the 1.3.0 + CRS:84 variant returns blank transparent tiles. Content guard added to validation.

bruciel_1944.name: BruCiel orthophotos 1944
bruciel_1944.status: WMS layer unavailable in test request
bruciel_1944.note: GetMap fails with LayerNotDefined under every tested version; the capabilities entry is a dead cascade (cascaded=1) and the documented BDU_DEP workspace no longer exists on any server. Treat the endpoint as retired; find an alternative 1944-era source.

brussels_archives.name: Brussels Archives image collection
brussels_archives.note: Confirm reuse terms, credit and possible fees for each selected image.

urbis_buildings.name: UrbIS buildings technical specification
urbis_buildings.note: The reviewed technical specification documents geometry, addresses and identifiers but does not demonstrate an individual construction-year field.

planning_permits.name: City of Brussels planning and environmental permits
planning_permits.note: Test address or building matching for later reconstruction evidence; permits should not be treated as original construction years without verification.
